sonnet.problem: The card says "Matthew says..." as if Matthew were a named person. Matthew 12 does not name its own writer, so the card should use the book's name ("the Gospel of Matthew") or "the writer".
sonnet.rule: When a book doesn't name its writer, he says "the writer," or what the text calls him, like "the elder." He can still use the book's name, like "the Gospel of John."
